dialogue_texts: Berenice
Muh huh huh... Did you think all of my attacks were enough? You're already witnessing the rebirth of the Order...
Reimu
I... I can't keep up. Your danmaku... it's like coming from two directions at once.
Berenice
It is coming from two directions, Reimu. The worlds are overlapping now. Your indecision has let the continent's borders blur beyond repair.
Reimu
Just give me... one more minute. I can still seal the rift... and always refer to me as "Your Honor!"
Berenice
The sun has already dipped below the horizon. Look at your surroundings. The day you were fighting for is being swallowed.
Reimu
What's happening? Why is my body starting to glow red!?
Berenice
You have failed to choose a reality, and society will now abandon you. You are now a resident of the Order.
Reimu
Wait! I don't want to be glohmed! I won't get back to the shrine!
Berenice
I will learn to control your soul soon enough. The Order's power is not yet fully restored, but it will come in time.
Berenice
If you will become my faithful servant, I will not harm you.
Too bad! Bad ending! To see the good ending, clear the game without using a continue or letting nine hours pass.
